Graduate Program Application Timeline
Prospective students can use this timeline to help them prepare their application, submit on time, and better understand the review process.
Overview
Applications are generally due about nine months prior to the desired enrollment semester. Following the application deadline, applications are reviewed over the next 1-4 months. All students will be notified by April (fall applicants) or November (spring applicants - Master's only).
